# sspi_vsphere_providers (Data Source)

Lists every vCenter provider registration known to the SSPI appliance.

Corresponds to `GET /sspi/providers`. Returns all results in a single page (no offset/page_size pass-through); use `data.sspi_vsphere_provider` for the full details of a specific provider.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) The vCenter providers known to the SSPI appliance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>

### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the provider registration.
- `server` (String) vCenter server IP or FQDN.
- `user` (String) vCenter username used for this registration.
